title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The final lateral displacement y must be correctly calculated as 0.017 m.

title: Coriolis Force
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly identify and apply the Coriolis force in the context of the problem.

title: Equations of Motion
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive the correct equations of motion for the body under the influence of gravity and Coriolis force.

title: Integration Steps
description: Important Criteria: The student must show the correct integration steps to find the displacement in the y-direction.

title: Time of Fall
description: Essential Criteria: The time of fall must be calculated correctly using the equation t = sqrt(2h/g).

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes in the equations of motion.

title: Centrifugal Effects
description: Optional Criteria: The student may mention the negligible effect of centrifugal force in this scenario.
